review_candidates.title: Integration Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the job About swypex swypex is transforming financial management for businesses with a seamless, intuitive, and unified platform. We are redefining outdated, complex systems to empower businesses with real-time visibility, control, and efficiency. About the Role swypex is hiring an Integrations Engineer to own the surface area where our platform meets the rest of our customers’ financial stack, their ERPs, their accounting tools, and the internal workflows our own operations, finance, and compliance teams run every day. This is a hands-on role that blends product engineering with internal tooling. You will build and maintain the ERP integrations our customers rely on (Alloy, Odoo, and more), ship internal admin apps in Appsmith and Budibase, automate repetitive workflows for internal teams, and occasionally help external developers integrating with our Partner API. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, operations, customer success, and finance, and your work will be felt directly by every customer that touches swypex. What You’ll Do Build and maintain ERP integrations. Design, build, and operate integrations between swypex and the ERPs our customers use, Alloy, Odoo, and others as we grow. Own data modeling, sync reliability, credential and webhook management, and the monitoring that surfaces issues before customers do. Ship internal tools in Appsmith and Budibase. Build new admin apps against our internal API and evolve the ones our operations, finance, compliance, and support teams already depend on. Treat these tools as first-class engineering work, versioned, reviewed, and reliable. Automate internal workflows. Identify repetitive or error-prone work across internal teams and replace it with thoughtful automation that scales with the business. Support Partner API customers. Help external developers integrating with our Partner API, review their questions, spot gaps in our docs and SDKs, and feed issues back to the core API team. Volume is low, but quality matters. Own the integrations roadmap. Partner with product, operations, and customer-facing teams to prioritize which integrations to build next, and how. What We’re Looking For 2–5 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong programming fundamentals in at least one modern backend language. TypeScript/Node, Python, Kotlin/Java, or similar. You don’t need to know our exact stack on day one, but you should pick up new languages and frameworks quickly. Solid working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, HMAC signatures) plus the failure modes that show up when two systems try to stay in sync. Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and the ability to write SQL you’d be comfortable running in production. A product-minded approach to internal tools. You care about the people using what you build, even when they sit one desk away. Clear written communication. A meaningful part of this role is documenting integrations, writing runbooks, and explaining tricky behavior to non-engineers. Nice to Have Hands-on experience integrating with or building on top of ERP systems; Odoo, Alloy, NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar. Exposure to fintech, payments, cards, or accounting domains, general ledger concepts, reconciliation, double-entry bookkeeping, or card processing flows. Experience building internal tools with low-code platforms (Appsmith, Budibase, Retool, or similar).

Hands-on experience with Jira Automation . Experience configuring dashboards, reports, views, and roadmaps. Good understanding of Jira permission schemes, roles, and access controls. Product Management & Agile Good understanding of product discovery methodologies. Experience with product roadmapping and prioritization frameworks. Knowledge of requirements management and stakeholder management. Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and product development lifecycles. Ability to translate business and product requirements into Jira configurations and workflows. Technical Skills Working knowledge of Jira REST APIs . Experience with Atlassian Automation. Basic knowledge of SQL and reporting concepts. Understanding of integrations involving Jira, DevOps, and other enterprise tools. Knowledge of APIs, webhooks, or third-party integrations is an advantage. Soft Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Good process design and documentation skills. Strong attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently in an onsite client environment. Experience 3+ years of experience in Jira Administration. 1+ year of hands-on experience with Jira Product Discovery. Proven experience configuring and administering Atlassian Cloud environments. Experience implementing or optimizing product discovery processes across multiple teams. Experience working with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, and Business teams. Experience in enterprise-scale Atlassian environments is highly desirable. Preferred Certifications Atlassian Certified Professional (ACP) Atlassian Cloud Administration Certification Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) Other relevant Atlassian, Agile, Scrum, or Product Management certifications

Applicants can expect to work with diverse industrial clients and advanced automation technologies in a technically challenging environment. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Senior Technical Sales Engineer role based in Qesm El Maadi. The person in this role will engage with industrial clients to understand their automation and control system needs, propose SIEMENS-based solutions, and support the full sales cycle from opportunity identification to deal closing. Daily activities include preparing technical and commercial proposals, conducting site visits, delivering product and system demonstrations, and coordinating closely with engineering teams to ensure accurate solution design. The Senior Technical Sales Engineer will provide technical support before and after sales, assist with troubleshooting and system upgrades, and maintain strong, long-term customer relationships. The role also involves tracking market trends, contributing to sales forecasts, and representing the company in meetings, presentations, and industry events. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Technical Sales and Sales Engineering skills, including solution selling and the ability to translate complex automation requirements into clear proposals. Candidates should possess solid Technical Support capabilities, with hands-on experience in industrial automation, control systems, and troubleshooting of equipment such as PLCs, inverters, and converters. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, with the ability to present technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and build trusted client relationships. Candidates should possess Sales skills focused on opportunity development, negotiation, and closing, supported by a customer-centric approach and ethical sales practices. Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in industrial automation. Proven experience with SIEMENS automation platforms, SCADA systems, and control system modernization projects is highly beneficial. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in preparing technical documentation, quotations, and project reports. Ability to work on-site at customer locations when required, collaborate in cross-functional teams, and manage multiple opportunities in a fast-paced environment.
